notes.title: Bug fixes and AI model adjustments
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]  Fixed an issue where scrolling after narrowing conditions in the “Original Questions” selection caused the content to change.
[*]  Set the default maximum room capacity to 20 participants.
[*] Updated the OpenAI model to GPT-4.1.
[*] When a user joins a room where a game is already in progress, their life count is now initialized to the room’s current life settings.
[*] Fixed an issue where an answer was incorrectly marked as correct when the correct word was a common term likely to appear in the question text.
[/list]

notes.title: English version released!
notes.notes:
The English release is available today!

You can play the following questions.
[list]
[*]Character
[*]Country
[*]Game
[*]HistoricalFigure
[*]Movie
[*]TouristSpot
[/list]

Users can also create their own original questions to play with!

notes.title: Official Release & Celebration Sale Now Live!
notes.notes:
Thank you for supporting the early access version of Deduce Together!
Thanks to your enthusiasm, we’re thrilled to announce the official release of Deduce Together today!

To show our gratitude, we’re kicking off a Release Celebration Sale with 33% OFF!
Don’t miss this opportunity to enjoy the game with your friends!
The sale will run for two weeks.

[h1]Patch Notes v1.0.0[/h1]

[h2]New Feature: Single-Player Challenge Mode[/h2]

Introducing Challenge Mode, designed for advanced players!
Aim to answer 50 questions correctly in a row within a limited number of attempts.

Currently, you can take on Beginner and Intermediate Character Quizzes, as well as Country Name Quizzes.

We plan to add more quiz types in the future!

notes.title: Feature Update Notice
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the filtering feature overlapped with hints when the hints were too long.
[*] Updated the error report popup to display the correct answer.
[/list]

notes.title: Announcement of Mac OS Version Release
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Supported on Mac OS.
[*] Compatible with Mac OS 11.0 (Big Sur) and later.
[*] Cross-play with the Windows version is available.
[/list]

notes.title: Feature Release Announcement
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Lobby functionality has been added.
[*]The selection status of questions and answers can now be changed by pressing Ctrl + arrow keys left and right.
[/list]

notes.title: Feature Release and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]You can now set the number of lives between 2 and 10.
[*]You can now configure the room settings to prevent the AI from giving hints. (The default is with hints)
[*]You can now set a penalty for correct answers in the quiz. (The default is no penalty)
[*]You can now change the AI's tone. (This is a beta feature)
[*]Fixed an issue where an error would occur when sorting more than 100 questions in the original quiz.
[/list]

notes.title: Announcement: Release of the Original Quiz Search Feature
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]We have added a search feature for original quizzes.
You can now set quizzes as public or private. As of this update, all original quizzes are set to private by default.
To make a quiz public and display it in the community's quiz list, check the box marked "Make quiz public" in the quiz creation screen.
[*]After entering the quiz code for an original quiz, you can now set the number of questions, answer time, and the number of players needed to win before starting the quiz.
[/list]

notes.title: Announcement of Intermediate-Level Character Quiz Release
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]- Added new Intermediate-Level Character Quiz questions.
[/list]
There are now 402 questions in total.

As for future plans, we’re considering swapping some questions between the beginner and intermediate levels based on accuracy rates. The intermediate level includes some pretty challenging questions, so give them a try!

notes.title: [Announcement] New Feature Release and UI
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that you can now create your own custom quizzes!

To learn how to create your original quizzes, please check out the guide here:
https://push-forward.notion.site/9c123f636ab049b6b1b787503a6460f4?pvs=74


You can also play quizzes created by others. Find out how here:
https://push-forward.notion.site/350c953bdd6c47888ac6ca7eac9d4230 

Minor Feature Updates:
We’ve made improvements to the UI when other users post messages while you’re scrolling. Now, when you scroll to the top, new messages from other users will automatically load.
